values.note: $28 a night for a standard or RV non-electric site, $38 for the electric site (008); the mini-group double site is $40 and the group site $58. Extra vehicles are paid to the host on arrival.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232157/rates (2026 seasons May 13 - Oct 11: STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC $28, RV ELECTRIC $38; peak-season $40 rate) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/rosy-lane-campground-gunnison-rd ('$10 per night electric fee'; 'Mini-group double site $40 per night'; 'Group Site: $58 per night') + recreation.gov notice ('Extra Vehicles: Cannot be paid for in advance - upon arrival coordinate with the host for payment'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: FS counts 20 campsites; recreation.gov lists 15 (11 reservable, 4 first-come), driveways 25-50 ft with 10 of the 15 at 45-50 ft and 8 pull-throughs. Site 004 is accessible.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/rosy-lane-campground-gunnison-rd ('20 campsites.') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232157 (Max Vehicle Length 25-50 ft; Driveway Entry Pull-Through on 001, 002, 004, 006, 013, 015, 016, 017, 019) + https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232157 ('Site 004 is accessible.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Nearest dump station is 16 miles north of the campground.

values.note: FS: 'Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent'. In 2026 recreation.gov's fee seasons ran May 13 - Oct 11 (first-come only before June 12 and after Sept 12); its 2027 table so far ends Sept 30. Opening and closing dates are weather permitting.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232157/rates (2026: First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-06-11; Peak Season 2026-06-12 to 2026-09-12; First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-13 to 2026-10-11) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/rosy-lane-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use: Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent') + recreation.gov notice ('Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Four sites (006, 008, 013, 019) are first-come and must be taken in person, and the whole campground is first-come outside the June 12 - Sept 12 reservation season. The weekend two-night minimum may be relaxed for a same-day booking. A reservation is held 24 hours past check-in before it counts as a no-show.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232157 (facility_rules: reservationCutOff 4, minWeekendStay 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices: 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person. DO NOT call to determine availability'; 'Late Arrivals: campers are not considered a "no-show" until 24 hours after arrival date check in time') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-06-12 to 2026-09-12) + catalog (006, 008, 013, 019 Not Reservable) + FS page ('a combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: Gunnison NF campground at 8,600 ft in Taylor River Canyon, 17 mi from Gunnison (CO 135 north to Almont, then 7 mi up paved Taylor Canyon Rd/CR 742), on the bank of the Taylor River among lodgepole pine and aspen; sites are set back from the water, which a trail reaches (Gold Medal fishing; calm stretch for rafting). No ATVs in the campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20 sites (FS), site 008 15-amp electric (public, first-come), vault toilets, potable water, reservable with some first-come sites. Changed max_rig_ft 30->50 (catalog driveways 25-50 ft, the '~30 ft' had no source), fees high 40->38 (the $40 is the double site), season closes 09-12 (calendar edge)->05-13..10-11 (2026 fee seasons, first-come shoulders). Added pull-through, booking season/cutoff/min/max stay, dump-station note, fees checked 2026. Note rewritten.
flags: Phone missing: Gunnison Ranger District (970) 641-0471. The concessionaire lines on recreation.gov are 970-642-0566 and (928) 537-8888 (email camping@rrmofa.com).

Lone electric site: site 008 is the only electric site and is not reservable online, but it is a public first-come site, not a host pad: recreation.gov's description advertises 'Site 008 has 15-Amp electric hookups', the 2026 rate table prices 'Walk In RV ELECTRIC' at $38, and the FS page lists a '$10 per night electric fee'. Kept electric 15.
Site count: FS says 20 campsites; the recreation.gov catalog lists 15 (numbers 001-019 with gaps). Kept 20.

Season: the FS 'Late Spring to Early Fall' wording and the 2026 fee seasons (May 13 - Oct 11) replace the derived calendar edge 09-12, which was only the end of the reservation season; the 2027 rate table currently ends the first-come season Sept 30.

Waterfront (stored riverview) kept: the Taylor River (~15-20 m wide) runs along the campground's north side; on NAIP the nearest catalog points (004, 005, 008) are ~20-40 m from the channel under pine canopy, and the FS page says a trail from the campground provides access to the river. No pad shows on the bank.

Pin 38.73063,-106.74634 is ~90 m from the catalog centroid and ~30 m from the nearest site, at the campground beside CR 742. OK. The Gold Mountain Wildfire closure listed on the page applies to the Ouray RD, not Taylor Canyon.
